title: Find out whether the redline copy pastes as a picture in a Chromium chat
goal: Shift Command C puts the redlined picture and its spec list on the clipboard together, so one paste hands off both. Slack, Discord and Teams are built on Chromium, and Chromium apps that see text and a picture on the clipboard together often paste the text, the way a copied spreadsheet range pastes as text in Slack. If that happens here, a person handing off a redline pastes a block of numbers instead of the picture. The check the original task asked a person to make was never made. Find out on this Mac without sending anything anywhere, and act on what it shows.
notes: From a 2026-10-08 manager review of measure-redline. Copy code: Sources/Photonz/EditorState.swift copyCompositeToClipboard (PNG, TIFF, then .string when Experiments measurePanelEnabled; CompositeCopy.representations). Original task one-copy-hands-off-both-the-redlined-picture-and (done); its audit queue/audits/2026-09-02-copy-image-spec-list.json rough 1 says Messages, Slack and Discord were never tried by a person; a WebKit field, a rich NSTextView and plain fields behaved as intended. Chromium was not tried. Do not paste into any real chat or web service: anything pasted there is published. A copied spreadsheet range (text plus picture) pasting as text in Slack is the known pattern behind the worry; unverified for this clipboard. Redlining is the user primary use, so a wrong paste matters.
acceptance: A local page (file:// or 127.0.0.1, never a real chat service) with a textarea and a contenteditable box, opened in a Chromium browser on this Mac, records what a paste of the Shift Command C clipboard delivers: the clipboardData types and files, and what lands in each box by default
The same paste is tried in TextEdit and in a WebKit editable field, for comparison with the 2026-09-02 audit
The findings, with the page and the exact steps, are written into this task log and an audit under queue/audits/
If the picture lands everywhere a picture can go: the task closes, no change

If Chromium takes the text over the picture: a decision card asks how the hand-off should work (for example the picture alone on Shift Command C with the list on its own command, or the list only when there are measurements), and the task is blocked on it
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced the real clipboard: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/redline-walk.json (passed, screen unlocked, Screen Recording granted) ends on Copy Merged (Shift Command C) with 5 measurements; board dump: public.png 120422 B, public.tiff 5.5 MB, public.utf8-plain-text 173 B. User's clipboard saved before and restored after.

Chromium, local file:// page with a textarea and a contenteditable box, Command V sent as the editor Paste command over the DevTools protocol (docs/design/references/redline-paste-check/cdp.mjs). Chrome 153 and Edge 154 (headed, throwaway profiles, opened with open -g, closed after): paste event types [text/plain, Files], items [string text/plain, file image/png], files [image.png image/png 120422 B]. Textarea got the spec list. Contenteditable got one (data:image/png) and no text. Headless Chrome is useless here: it has its own empty clipboard (types []).

Comparison: WKWebView on the same page: types [Files, text/plain] (picture listed first), textarea = list, contenteditable = 1 image, no text. NSTextView rich+importsGraphics (TextEdit rich document) = 1 image, no text; plain NSTextView (TextEdit plain) = list; rich without graphics = list. Matches the 2026-09-02 audit. Real TextEdit not driven (no Automation permission; would prompt).

Verdict per acceptance: the picture lands everywhere a picture can go at the platform level, so no change and no decision card. Not settled: Slack/Discord/Teams composers run their own paste handlers on top of Chromium; not tried because pasting into a real chat is publishing. Tried reading Discord's local cached client JS for its paste handler: cache is compressed, nothing readable, stopped. That last check is a person's (paste into a message box without sending) and sits in the audit's try/evaluate for the user, not filed as a loop task (the loop cannot do it). Left rough (log only): Chromium orders text before the file in DataTransfer, so a first-match handler would take the list; speculative, nothing observed does that.

Kit and steps committed under docs/design/references/redline-paste-check/ (README, page, CDP driver, clipboard save/restore, WebKit/NSTextView probe). Note added to docs/design/next-measure.md section 7. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-08-redline-paste.json.
owns no walks; the ones it names are examples

Checked on this Mac with the real Shift Command C clipboard (redline-walk): Chrome 153 and Edge 154 hand a local page both text/plain and image.png; a contenteditable box takes the picture alone, a textarea takes the list; WebKit and a TextEdit-style rich text view match. No app change, no decision card. Kit in docs/design/references/redline-paste-check, audit queue/audits/2026-10-08-redline-paste.json. Slack/Discord/Teams paste code untried (never paste into a real chat): left to the user as an unsent paste in the audit.
